messages:
ashley: quick heads-up — noticed a lingering service-account blob in staging logs from last night's partner webhook deploy. looks like a base64 SA key got logged by the webhook handler.

jordan: ugh. do we have the file path or log snippet? can you paste the minimal example (masking actual creds) so we can search?

ashley: pasted snippet (masked): `POST /webhook partner=acme body={...\"config\":\"eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJI...\"}`
contains `eyJ` header pattern like a key. saw it in stackdriver: projects/redwood-staging/logs/app_logs payload.

lenora: are these already expired SA keys or still valid?

ashley: still valid — created last month. I blocked the webhook endpoint and removed access for the staging SA in IAM.

mike: good call. we should rotate both the SA json and any KMS-wrapped ciphertexts that referenced it. recommend flow: 1) revoke/rollback leases in Vault if mounted, 2) rotate SA, 3) rewrap KMS keys used for backups, 4) update sealed secrets and CI secrets, 5) audit.

samir: on the Vault side: any secrets written as transit-wrapped ciphertext or just plain kv?

ashley: a mix. older handler wrote the raw JSON to /secret/data/partner/webhooks (kv v2). new handler was supposed to write only the KMS-wrapped blob to /transit/encode but there are 2 entries with plain JSON in kv.

lenora: action items then — we need an expunge + rotation plan. propose short plan and owners:
- hunt & expunge plaintext entries (ashley + jordan)
- rotate SA in GCP (mike)
- rewrap backup ciphertexts (samir)
- revoke vault leases + regeneration of tokens (lenora)
- CI credential swap and rollout (jordan)
- enable verbose audit logging to remote S3 for 90d retention (sec-bot/oncall)

ashley: I'll run a scoped grep across logs + k8s volumes for the base64 pattern and list affected paths by EOD.

jordan: for rotation, mike — can you create a new SA with minimal scopes and do key replacement? please include the new key's storage path so I can update CI.

mike: yes. plan: create new SA 'webhook-staging-rot-2026', grant only storage.objects.get for partner buckets, disable old key, then delete old key after validation. command I'll run: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create /tmp/webhook-staging-rot.json --iam-account=webhook@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com` then upload to sealed-secrets.

samir: once we have the new key, rewrap step: for each KMS-wrapped blob referencing the old key, run `gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=old.cipher --plaintext-file=- --keyring=... | gcloud kms encrypt --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=new.cipher --key=...` — or use Vault transit rewrap if centrally stored. we should record mapping so we don't lose history.

oncall: audit logging note: increase retention for the project audit logs and enable bucket-level object versioning for the S3 export. also add an alert for any future logs containing `eyJ0eXAi` pattern; I can add that rule.

lenora: RBAC tweak: lock down Vault write to /secret/data/partner/* so only a new role `webhook-rotator` can write during the window. after rotation run, revoke that role. I'll prepare the policy and apply in a staging namespace. policy snippet: `path \"secret/data/partner/*\" { capabilities = [\"read\"] }` (we'll grant write only to `webhook-rotator`).

ashley: note — there are also archived backups in GCS with the old blob. mike can you rotate/rewrap those and mark for reingest?

mike: yes, will schedule a job to re-encrypt backups with new key and update metadata. ETA 6 hours. will post status.

jordan: CI swap plan: create ephemeral secrets in Vault for CI runners, update GH Actions to fetch from Vault transit/unwrap at runtime. stop storing long-lived plaintext in repo.

samir: when revoking vault leases do `vault lease revoke -prefix secret/partner` then run `vault kv metadata delete` for the plaintext entries after we have the backup. also rotate transit keys if used for signing.

ashley: I'm starting the grep now. found 3 files in k8s pod volumes referencing the base64 string. uploading a short list to the incident board.

sec-bot: security incident created: INC-2026-572. Assigned to: eng-security. Severity: S2. Audit trails: enabled.

lenora: good. let's meet in 30m in #incidents to coordinate the live cutover for the webhook. please bring commands and owners.

mike: will bring the SA rotation steps and backup rewrap job script.

jordan: bringing CI update patch and a canary rollout plan (10% pods). will coordinate with eng-oncall for rollback hooks.

ashley: thanks all — I'll DM the partner to notify them we rotated keys and that staging exposure was contained. will update the thread with final list of deleted plaintext entries. :thumbsup:

oncall: logging alert rule added: `log_matches(\"eyJ0eXAi\", severity>=ERROR) -> paging to #eng-security` — tweak if noisy.

lenora: post-mortem owners: lenora (writeup), ashley (remediation verification), mike (gcp key hygiene), jordan (ci vault migration), samir (rewrap audit). target publish in 7 days.

ashley: updating incident ticket now. I'll post the final cleanup commands and `kubectl` ops after I finish the grep.

mike: old key disabled. new key in place. starting backup rewrap.

samir: rewrap done for 18/23 backups, will finish by +2h. creating mapping doc.

jordan: CI patch merged to main; canary started, no errors so far.

ashley: plaintext entries removed from Vault (listed in INC ticket). verified no further occurrences in logs. closing the temporary webhook block.

lenora: reopening RBAC to normal state in 15m after verification window.

sec-bot: incident INC-2026-572 status: mitigated.

ashley: final note — we should add a pre-commit check in the webhook handler repo that rejects commits that include base64 SA-like patterns and add runtime scrubbing. filing a tech debt ticket.

lenora: agreed. thanks everyone.
